Results.ReviewText: I had my previous Weber for 10 years. It was a superior product and worth every penny of the $500 purchase. I didn’t/couldn’t spend that much right now so instead of spending that much on a warehouse brand or a brand with lesser cache, I bought a smaller Weber for $649.  This thing is so flimsy. The temp gauge has moisture in it and I can’t seem like to control the temperature like I could the old one. I realize it’s been 10 years so I would have to spend more than I did way back when but the technology hasn’t changed, and the downgrade in materials seems to more than off-set inflation. In my opinion, not worth the money.
Results.Title: Cheaply made. Not what Weber used to be.

Results.ReviewText: It’s been good so far but the reason for the four rating is there’s nothing about it got holding lower temps unless you turn off a burner I had to call in still not convinced but I’m trying it
Results.Title: Temp keeps climbing on lowest setting

Results.ReviewText: This grill is great and I particularly love the propane tank fuel level indicator which is standard on this grill and even on the smaller version. The tank hangs of a small scale inside the BBQ and the indicator will move as the level of fuel is consumed. The heat control is good and the space of the grill is perfect for a small to medium size deck. The quality of the product is good and was easy to assemble so don’t pay to have this done. Overall I give it 9 stars out of 10 as it is a bit more expensive than other grills of similar quality and size.
Results.Title: Great grill with features you’ll love!

Photos.Caption: BBQ lid with divot & paint chipped off
Bottom right side panel, with a large bend in it.
The replacement right side panel is in the photo on the right. It is missing the top hole and nut, which should align with the back panel, see on the left side in the photo.

Results.ReviewText: Purchased the Spirit E-310 for my daughter's 40th birthday. While assembling it, I found a defect on the lid and the right bottom panel also had significant damage to it (box it came in had no damage to it). Called and requested replacement parts. New lid was find, but the replacement bottom panel had a mfg defect. I called again and the rep. insisted it was the back panel that had an issue (I included pics for reference). Finally he confirmed I was right and ordered a 2nd replacement. The following day I received an email from Weber, that stated I was being sent a back panel. No explanation. I got on the phone AGAIN! and was told this model is being discontinued, so they were sending me a back panel which would address the problem with the side panel. It's been 2 weeks and I haven't received the back panel, nor a shipping confirmation email. Radio Silence. I am beyond dissatisfied. I have always had a Weber, but no more!
Results.Title: Poor quality control and customer service

Results.ReviewText: It’s the best bbq I ever had. Very consistent heat and don’t need to have it on high to get to a consistent temp. Does a great job with all meats. Would highly recommend it.
Results.Title: The best aver.

Results.ReviewText: Cooks very well but clean up very difficult with removable tray and placement of a 20 pound tank on an internal scale is ridiculous
Results.Title: The good and the bad

Results.ReviewText:
I am happy with Spirit Grill. Had to get the burner replaced under warranty. It was a great experience working with the customer service team.
Would highly recommend Weber
Results.Title: Great features and service

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together, looks great on my deck.  So far has lit every time and cooking temperature is easy to control.  Heats up fast.  I usually buy cheap grills, decided to treat myself to a Weber this time.
Results.Title: Nice Grill

Results.ReviewText: I prefer the warming rack in the lid. This gets in the way when grilling large amounts of food.
Results.Title: Move the warming rack.

Results.ReviewText: Great bbq!  Easy to assemble. Lights immediately when the button is pushed.  Heats evenly even when I use two of the three burners.  I’m very happy with my Weber.
Results.Title: Excellent quality.   Weber makes a great Bbq

Results.ReviewText: Enjoy this grill.  Needs to be preheated but then holds heat well.  Easy to clean which is nice.
Results.Title: Nice grill fair price.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve always used Weber grills for over 30 years and have always liked them.  Good quality grill.
Results.Title: The griller

Results.ReviewText: Replacing my 12 year old 210.  This one is well built and I expect this 310 to last just as long.  I do wish the shelves folded down as they did with the previous grill.
Results.Title: New E-310

Results.ReviewText: Heats and cooks incredibly well.  As good as the grill I have at home that cost 10 times as much.
Results.Title: Value vs Price

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to use on our houseboat, usually just cooking for two of us.  It is the perfect size grill, and the three burners give a lot of options.  Food doesn't stick to the porcelain grate (keep it clean per the instructions), and the heat is consistent across the cooking surface.  I chose to have the grill shipped direct and assemble myself.  Packaging and assembly instructions were great.  This is my third Weber grill.
Results.Title: Perfect size three burner grill.

Your grill is backed with an outstanding warranty. Our Specialist team will help with a replacement and get you grilling again soon. Please look for our email outreach. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: So far I’m not impressed.  I used my new Spirit 310 twice.  My wife was cleaning the exterior the next day with a soft cloth and while wiping the front of it, the entire push starter assembly crumbled into pieces.  I am currently waiting for a replacement part.  Not what I expected from a Weber….
Results.Title: Cheap plastic/ rubber parts

Results.ReviewText: Throughly enjoy the even heat and minimal flare ups also the propane tank gauge, removable bottom and grease pan is nice to keep the unit clean and ready each time. Thanks Weber.
Results.Title: Finally !  Found an actual Grill

Results.ReviewText: The perfect grill for my wife and I. We're only two people so I don't need a large grill. And I'm not into fancy smokers or bells and whistles. I just want to grill up some steak now and then, maybe some corn or other veggies, and that's about it. This grill is just what we needed. I LOVE the feature that lets me know how much propane I have left! The grill is easy to clean and maintain and I couldn't be happier.
Results.Title: Wonderful grill, easy to clean, perfect size.

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill, great design, fit and finish is excellant.
Results.Title: I am a Weber guy

Results.ReviewText: Works great. On of the nicer grills i have owned. Exceptionaly well made.
Results.Title: Spirit grill

Results.ReviewText: Thank you so much for the warranty on burner transfer tube . I installed it (directions had you take apart many things you don't have to) I'm back to barbequing and extremely satisfied with My grill I now have 3 of them . My oldest is 24 years old and still works great . I tell everyone if interested in a grill don't buy anything but a WEBER !!!!!!!!!
Once assembled very easy to use. Has great flame control, easy to clean.
Results.Title: Excellent BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Had it for three weeks unreal bbq, but had some discolouring on the lid so I reached out to them. Show them some pictures and they sent me a brand new lid assembly! Thanks Weber
Results.Title: Great experience

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, built to last with high quality materials.
Results.Title: Sprit E-310

Results.ReviewText: The parts packaging and assembly book were perfect!  Everything fit together perfectly!
Results.Title: Foolproof assembly!

Results.ReviewText: I previously had this model for 10yrs & loved it. I did have to replace the grates 3 times as well as the protectors over the burners, but it always worked great. It was dropped in a move & was damaged beyond repair. Unfortunately, I replaced it with a less expensive competitor's product which did not hold up to my year round grilling habits in Michigan. I recently bought another Spirit E-310 & realized how much I missed it. It is a great grill & works exactly as it should. I grill several times per week year round & look foreword to many years of service from this grill.  I only hope these grates hold up better than my previous Spirit.  I highly recommend this grill!
Results.Title: A GREAT Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Always liked Weber grills. They don't flare up like cheaper grills. Definitely worth the money.
Results.Title: Weber spirit

Results.ReviewText:
This is the second WEBER grill we’ve bought fROM Lowe’s.  The first one was delivered missing parts so we sent it back.  The second Weber grill we bought was also delivered missing parts.
We kept it and are using it.  We were told the manager from Lowe’s would call -he never did.
I called Weber and they said they would send the missing pars.  Email from Weber said the part would be shipped in Aug., one month from delivery date.
Now I figure we’ll have to fight to get someone out to install the part if we ever get it.
Results.Title: Weber Grill parts shortage

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful Grill! It’s easy to operate. The grill grates are easy to clean. The built in propane tank scale is a GREAT feature. It’s important to note that care must be taken when reaching temp. Grill burns really hot and adjustments must be made. Also the handle gets a bit too warm to touch at times.
Results.Title: I’s Recommend This Grill

Results.ReviewText: Received the Spirit E310 as a gift and am very pleased. Easy to assemble and the grill is awesome. Even heat and easy to clean. The only reason I don’t give it 5 stars is that I wish the back of the grill was enclosed or closed to completely enclosed to keep critters and dogs out of the grease trap. Even with cover they find there way in. Other than that I love it and recommend to anyone considering.
Results.Title: Awesome Father’s Day gift

Results.ReviewText: This is a quality product. I have never had such consistent bbq results before. Keeping the burners and the tray clean is important; but all parts that need to be removed for a thorough clean are easy to remove. The cooking guide is excellent.
Results.Title: Quality product!

Results.ReviewText: We like the Weber Grill; however, the LP Hose Regulator (QCC1/Type 1) did not fit correctly & leaks.  We've contacted the retailer for repair & awaiting their response.  Hope to hear back from them and/or Weber on the possible defect or part replacement.
Results.Title: We like the Weber Grill; however....

Results.ReviewText: Awesome barbecue, replacement for a 20 year old Genesis Silver
Results.Title: Great barbecue

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had the grill for 7 years. Every part that could rust or deteriorate has done so but Weber offers replacement parts for everything. I cannot compare to other grills as this is my first. Wish it was a little more rust proof. The cover’s velcro lost its stickiness too. I have to tie it down.
Results.Title: Rusts easily

Results.ReviewText:
This grill was given to me as a Fathers day/Birthday present by my children and wife. I had owned a 2 burner weber for many years and kept it operational but in hind sught it was past its usefulness. Everytime I would need parts from Weber it was old enough that there was no model number on it and they would have a hard time determining how to supply what I needed but thankfully they always did.
When I received the new grill I really didn't think it was necessary but after using it multiple times  I find it is now a joy to grill again. 
I should have done this years ago.
Thank you to my family and Weber for supplying such a fine product.
I COULDN'T BE HAPPIER!!
Results.Title: Great improvement

Results.ReviewText: Hands down, the best grill I've ever owned.  It lights first time, every time, the heat is perfectly distributed thru the whole grill, it looks good and I love the fill gauge to tell me when to replace it.
Results.Title: Great Grill

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
